profile.headline: Web Developer & Operations Specialist at University of California, Santa Cruz
profile.summary: Experienced Technologist with a demonstrated history of working in the education, technology and medical industries. Skilled in SharePoint, Javascript, HTML, PHP , jQuery, React JS, cloud based technologies and external API usage. Strong professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Science from California State University, Monterey Bay looking to connect with alumni and industry professionals.  Currently pursuing a Master of Science (MS) focused in Software Engineering from California State University, Fullerton.

positions.title: Web Developer & Operations Specialist
positions.description:
• Using technology-based analysis of business practices, processes, and problems in order to develop solutions that involved process design, data and information architecture, software development and policy and/or procedural changes
• Responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of enhancements to the department's website, related forms, and content hosted on an underlying SharePoint platform.
• Contributed to the campus's net-zero carbon mission by integrating DocuSign's API service to the department's platform.

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description: • Prepared and taught weekly lesson plans focusing on computer science and basic web development to a group of twenty-five students, the results were students were able to construct their custom website when they came with none or very little knowledge.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Assessed security measures and consulted on software and tools that were vital to business operations.
• Used Amazon Web Services in order to administer server, network security, and management of backups. 
• Organized and implemented Google Analytics data tracking campaigns to maximize the effectiveness of website remarketing initiatives that were deployed.

positions.title: Data Center Administrator
positions.description:
• Administered enterprise solutions with many different hardware and software configurations, setup and removing server/networking hardware
• Participated with other teams to troubleshoot customer related issues while continuously improving SLA metrics
• Worked on migrating 1000+ customers over the network to another facility, a first for the company

positions.title: Student Intern, Lab and Distance Education
positions.description:
- Trained faculty to use modern technology and software in courses to enrich the student experience, and maintained a computer lab
- Redesigned school library homepage, updated and maintained the department’s webpage as well as implemented a spam preventer via web forms

projects.title: Blindbites
projects.description:
● A deployed cross-platform application that provides local food choices for indecisive food cravers
● Written in ReactJS along with React Native, other libraries and third party APIs

projects.title: postAR
projects.description:
● Cross platform application that allows users to interact socially using your GPS location
● Written using ReactJS and React Native with a backend server using Node.js and MongoDB
